Non-destructive testing services in Huntsville: laboratory, field and program work compared

People searching for non-destructive testing services in Huntsville usually need one of three things: examination of parts in an accredited laboratory, a crew at a plant or test site, or help building an NDT program. These are different purchases with different suppliers. Atlantis does the second and third. It sends conventional NDT crews to Huntsville sites and provides ASNT Level III program work. It does not run a laboratory and is not Nadcap accredited.

Which kind of NDT provider does your job need?

  • Production parts for flight or missile hardware. When a purchase order requires an accredited laboratory or the prime contractor's approval of the NDT source, the parts go to a laboratory that holds it. Check the purchase order before asking anyone for a quote.
  • Plant equipment, structures and test-stand hardware. Air receivers, autoclaves, crane runways, press frames, chemical plant piping and tanks are examined where they stand by a field crew working to ASME or AWS codes and the owner's program. This is Atlantis work.
  • NDT program development. A machine shop or fabricator adding in-house NDT needs a written practice, method procedures, examinations and an outside Level III. That is consulting, and it is what the "Level 3 program development" searches from Alabama are after.

Who offers NDT around Huntsville

Applied Technical Services announced a Huntsville location in April 2022, offering NDT both on site and in its laboratory. Prime contractors and large suppliers run in-house NDT departments for their own hardware, and national inspection firms serve the Decatur chemical corridor and the Tennessee Valley from regional branches. For buyers, the useful distinction is less about the name than the scope: whether the provider will send certified technicians to your site, which methods they staff, and which Level III answers for the procedures.

Conventional NDT on Huntsville plant and test equipment

  • UT thickness on air receivers, autoclave shells and process piping, to ASME Section V Article 23 practice, gives the owner or the state boiler inspector measured remaining wall. See ultrasonic testing in Huntsville.
  • Shear-wave UT of groove welds on structural weldments, tooling frames and transport stands, with acceptance from AWS D1.1 or the customer drawing.
  • MT on carbon steel crane hooks, runway girders, lifting fixtures and press frames: magnetic particle testing in Huntsville and MT of lifting equipment.
  • PT on aluminum, titanium and stainless ground support and test-stand welds: penetrant testing in Huntsville.
  • VT of welds and external condition, recorded with located photographs.

Questions to ask before you hire

  • Which personnel certification does your purchase order require? Atlantis technicians are certified under an employer written practice built on ASNT SNT-TC-1A; check that against the order before work starts.
  • Does the provider's procedure cite the method standard and revision your drawing calls for?
  • Who reviews the report, and is that person's Level III certificate on file with you?
  • For work on Redstone Arsenal, who sponsors site access and badging, and how long does it take?
  • Ask for the report issue date in writing before the crew mobilizes.

Gulf Coast marine work from Huntsville searches

Some searches here ask for marine NDT on the Gulf Coast. That work centers on Mobile Bay, where shipyards and terminals need hull and deck plate thickness gauging, MT on structural welds and PT on aluminum superstructure. See ultrasonic testing in Mobile, magnetic particle testing for marine and shipbuilding and third-party inspection in Mobile. Class-credited hull gauging needs a firm approved by the ship's class society; Atlantis is in the process of obtaining UR Z17 approval from DNV, Lloyd's Register and ABS, so until a certificate is issued its readings serve the owner's own decisions.

Working with Atlantis in North Alabama

Atlantis is based in Houston, and crews travel to Huntsville, Madison, Decatur and Athens for the agreed dates. Anoop Rayavarapu, ASNT NDT Level III in UT, RT, MT, PT and VT, signs off the procedures and checks the reports for Huntsville jobs. For program development see ASNT Level III consulting; for statewide scopes, NDT inspection services in Alabama. Send the asset, method and code through the Huntsville NDT enquiry; we reply within one business day.
